posts.name: FoldedDice
posts.cooked:
Well, after banging my head against the game for hours yesterday trying to get Mad Bomber Blade to unlock, I was pleasantly surprised to get Cosmic Omni on my first try. Of course, I found out ahead of time what needed to be done, so I can't give myself that much credit. Still, I my strategy for taking out both ships turned out to be very effective. I did the fight in Megalopolis with Absolute Zero, Haka, Bunker, and Tempest. Both ships were almost all the way at the bottom of the deck, so it turned out to be a fairly lengthy battle. I'll go though each character's role in detail, in case someone might find the information useful.

Absolute Zero - Not much to say here. He helped to soften the first invasion wave while the other heroes were still setting up and soaked up quite a bit of damage. Probably could have been someone different.

Haka - One half of my victory strategy. He did the bulk of minion-killing during the early game. Once I had Savage Mana and a sizable attack wave I had him use Rampage to put most of Voss's forces on lockdown. His health got dangerously low at one point, but a timely Haka of Restoration kept him going until the end. When both ships finally showed up, he took out the first one with Savage Mana (also discarding his entire hand to Haka of Battle, just for fun), hitting for 39 points.

Bunker - The second ship killer. He had a bad draw for the first several rounds, so he didn't contribute much to the fight until the very end. I eventually got him into Recharge Mode with his Heavy Plating in play, which negated most of the damage that came his way. He spent the rest of the fight quietly charging his Omni Cannon, in order to take out the second ship with a 44 point blast.

Tempest - He did a bit of healing and damage-dealing early on, But his main job was to become incapacitated. After that, I used his damage immunity ability to help keep the rest of the team alive while I waited for Voss's fleet to show up.
